cv.name: Priya Ganesan
cv.headline: UX Designer – Research-led product design for fintech and health
cv.summary: UX designer with five years across agency contracts, an early-stage startup and freelance work, now in-house at a superannuation fund. Comfortable running research, shaping flows and handing over clean Figma files to developers.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Redesigned the online rollover flow; completion rate rose from 54% to 71%
Run fortnightly usability sessions with members, including older and low-vision users
Contributed accessibility patterns to the design system against WCAG 2.2 AA
Work in a squad with two developers and a product owner using Jira and Figma

experience.title: Freelance UX/UI Designer
bullets: Projects for a physiotherapy clinic network and a local council's events website

experience.title: Product Designer
bullets: First design hire; designed onboarding for a telehealth app before the company paused operations

experience.title: UX Designer (contract)
bullets: Eight-month contract on wireframes and prototypes for retail clients
